packs.name: BP-BASSENSORSMKII Sensors BoosterPack plug-in module
packs.fit: Plugs on; I2C is on pins 9 and 10, the L1306's PA1 and PA0. The OPT3001 and TMP117 are powered from pins 27 and 28, which the L1306 does not have: two wires (27 to pin 12, PA23; 28 to pin 18, PA7) and seven jumpers out.
packs.pins: docs/boards/bp-bassensorsmkii.json: I2C 9, 10 (10 kOhm pull-ups on the board); pin 27 powers the OPT3001 and 28 the TMP117 (high = on); 6 and 24 enable the HDC2080 and DRV5055 (low = on).

rows.why: pin 27 by wire to PA23 (header pin 12): powers the OPT3001
who answers on the shared bus
rows.expect: 0x40 (HDC2080), 0x44 (OPT3001), 0x69 (BMI160), and 0x13 (BMM150) once awake; 0x48 only with the ribbon cable in and pin 28 high

packs.bench: in hand, stacked on the LP-MSPM0G5187: humidity and temperature, light and the magnet sensor read live; the BMI160 did not answer and the TMP117 needs its ribbon cable (see its guide)
packs.note: Predicted, not tested here: the Sensors BoosterPack is stacked on the LP-MSPM0G5187, not on the L1306.

packs.name: BOOSTXL-EDUMKII Educational BoosterPack MKII
packs.fit: Plugs on with pins 27 to 34 not connected: no screen (pin 31), no S1 or S2. The light sensor is on I2C pins 9 and 10. Jumpers J4 to J6, J1, J11, J3, J12, J13 and J2 come out on the L1306 (our arrival plan).
packs.pins: docs/boards/boostxl-edumkii.json: I2C 9, 10 (OPT3001 at 0x44, alert on 8); PWM 19, 37 to 40: servo, blue, green, red, buzzer.

rows.why: who answers on the BoosterPack's bus
header pin 37 drives the BoosterPack's blue LED (L1306 jumper J12 out)

packs.bench: in hand, stacked on the LP-MSPM33C321A
packs.note: Predicted, not tested here: the Education BoosterPack is stacked on the LP-MSPM33C321A, not on the L1306.

packs.name: BOOSTXL-SHARP128 display BoosterPack plug-in module
packs.fit: Plugs on with no wires. The screen speaks SPI (pins 7 and 15, select on 6), which this card cannot drive; what it can show is the display's power and on/off pins.
packs.pins: docs/boards/boostxl-sharp128.json: SPI 7, 15, select 6; GPIO 2 power and 5 on/off; SD card 8, 14, 17.

rows.why: header pin 5 is the display's on/off line (L1306 jumper J5 joins PA24 to the light sensor; pull it)
the display has no I2C part
rows.expect: nothing answers (the L1306's own pull-ups only)

packs.note: Predicted, not tested here: the display BoosterPack has not been plugged onto the L1306 yet.
